Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14918 of 2023
Applicant :- Om Prakash @ Bhore @ Motey Patharkat
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.
Prin. Secy. Deptt.Of Home Civil Sectt. Lko

Counsel for Applicant :- Dinesh Kr. Chaudhary
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Dinesh Kumar Chaudhary, the learned counsel for the applicant, Smt. Anupriya
Jaiswal, the learned counsel for the State and perused the records.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in FIR/Case Crime
No.344 of 2023, under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kotwali
Nagar, District Balrampur.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 11.10.2023 against three persons, including the applicant alleging that the accused persons had duped the applicant by taking Rs.37,000/- from him on the pretext that the money will be doubled.
Thereafter they escaped with the money.

4. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,

sentences.text: he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no previous criminal history except one Criminal Case No.559 of 2023 lodged on similar set of allegations and the applicant has been granted bail in that case by means of an order dated 15.12.2023, passed by this Court passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.14797 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.14797 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that as per the averments made in the F.I.R. the accused persons were not known to the informant,they met him on the way per chance, shown documents regarding their identity and thereafter duped him which story appears to be doubtful; that the applicant has no previous criminal history and in the other case of similar nature the applicant has already been granted bail by this court whereas in the present case he is languishing in jail since 12.10.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

Ram .
